digest.component_or_area: Jira family sub-seam layer for Cloud and Data Center support
propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center because the existing Cloud adapter uses REST v3 with ADF markup, account-id user identity, and PAT bearer auth via ACLI subprocess, while DC uses REST v2 with wiki/plain-text bodies, name-based user identity, and direct PAT bearer auth

prior attempt (PR #120) created a second adapter that forked field mapping logic and reached into private modules, creating an uncontracted shared layer with no boundary enforcement and risk of silent divergence between Cloud and DC

a consolidated Jira-family sub-seam must share field value maps, label/link sanitizers, and classify-probe by location rather than duplication, while parameterizing rich-text codec and user-identity model as contracts so Cloud and DC each provide their own implementation without file relocation or loader changes

the DC backend requires https for reconciler.base_url and rejects non-TLS URLs unless allow_insecure=true is set, never disables TLS certificate verification regardless of override, and reads the PAT from JIRA_PAT environment variable only (never from committed config)

operator-verified bidirectional reconciliation against real Jira 8.17.1 Data Center instance proves inbound and outbound passes work end-to-end, and the live harness stays green on every reconcile run as the exit bar for delivery
